name: Cue: Voice-Paced Prompter
subtitle: Script reader & video recorder
promotionalText: No subscription, no watermark. Voice Pace scrolls while you talk and stops when you pause, so you never chase the words.
description:
Cue is a teleprompter that keeps up with you instead of racing ahead.

Write or paste your script, tap Prompt and read. Turn on Voice Pace and the words move only while you're talking, then wait when you stop. No more chasing the text or scrolling back.

READ NATURALLY
• Voice Pace: the words move while you talk and wait when you pause. It listens to sound levels on your phone.
• Voice Follow: on-device speech recognition keeps your place as you read, in supported device languages.
• Steady scroll with speed nudges, a countdown and a timer.
• Big, clear text with a reading line. Pinch to resize, drag to scroll back, tap to pause.
• Mirror and flip for beam-splitter rigs. Landscape works too.

RECORD AT THE LENS
• Record with your script right under the camera, so your eyes stay near the lens.
• Every take goes straight to Photos. No watermark, ever.
• Record one section at a time and retake just the bit you fluffed.

WRITE FASTER
• Sections you can jump to, pause cues and private notes that are never read out.
• Fit any script to 30 seconds, a minute, 90 seconds or longer: Cue sets the pace for you.
• See the read time and words per minute as you write, with a live preview of the prompter.
• Import .txt and Markdown files. Search, pin, duplicate and share your scripts.

FREE, THEN ONE SMALL PAYMENT IF YOU WANT MORE
The teleprompter, steady scroll, recording and unlimited scripts are free. Start an optional free 7-day Trial from the Cue Plus screen to try every Plus feature. It starts only when you confirm the free trial item with Apple, and nothing is charged automatically when it ends. After that, Cue Plus is a single payment, not a subscription: Voice Pace and Voice Follow, caption files (.srt and .vtt timed to your pace), prompter colours, Word import and rehearsal stats.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. Your scripts, voice and videos stay on your phone unless you choose to share them. Limited technical data supports app updates; see the privacy policy.

reviewNotes:
Purpose and audience: Cue is a teleprompter for creators, presenters, teachers and anyone rehearsing or recording a talk.

Setup: No account or login. A Welcome script is included. Open it and tap Prompt for the prompter, or Record for video with the script at the lens. Scripts, steady scroll, mirror/flip and recording without a watermark are free.

Purchases: Settings > Cue Plus has Get Plus (one-time non-consumable), Start free 7-day trial (a separate free non-consumable named 7-day Trial), and Restore purchase. Trial access begins only after Apple confirms the free item, uses the original transaction date, and never charges automatically. After seven days, Voice Pace, Voice Follow, caption files, colours, Word import and rehearsal stats require Plus. Restore does not restart an expired trial. Please test both products with the submitted app.

Voice and privacy: Voice Pace measures sound levels using temporary local audio buffers deleted when stopped. Voice Follow matches words using on-device speech recognition and refuses unsupported on-device locales before recording. Camera access is for recording and Photos access is add-only. Scripts, voice and videos are not uploaded. Expo EAS Update delivers fixes and receives a random installation identifier and failed-update launch diagnostics for app functionality, with no identity linkage or tracking. Apple handles purchases. No ads, account service or behavioural analytics.

Regional differences: Store prices are localised; Voice Follow depends on the device supporting on-device recognition for its selected language. Voice Pace and Steady are alternatives. Regulated services and third-party content: not applicable. A physical-device screen recording can be provided if requested; no recording is claimed as attached.
